subject: CFRunLoopTimerInvalidate

observation.summary: CoreFoundation ships no standalone Mach-O on macOS 27 (/System/Library/Frameworks/CoreFoundation.framework/CoreFoundation is a broken symlink); its image is resident in the arm64e dyld shared cache (sha256 ecc822c56dbce82d0f151afd7bf8492e91b109944483614f0eaaf377ac7d21da), so otool-exports and nm-symbols both return status=tool-failed against this path. dyld_info resolves the canonical path through the cache and reads the image's LC_DYLD_EXPORTS_TRIE directly. source_artifact is the verbatim dyld_info export dump captured to the cache directory, which is the observed artifact. _CFRunLoopTimerInvalidate appears in the export trie as a function entry in the image's __TEXT segment (__TEXT spans 0x1808CD000-0x180D5D428 in the cache).

claim: CoreFoundation on macOS 27 exports CFRunLoopTimerInvalidate, which permanently disables a run-loop timer, as a __TEXT function symbol.
